Standard &lt; works.

Uppercase &LT; works (case-insensitive).

Mixed &Lt; should also resolve.

Standard &amp; vs &AMP; vs &Amp;.

Multi-letter &copy; vs &COPY; vs &Copy;.

Unknown &madeup; passes through.

Numeric &#65; case doesn't matter (decimal): A.
Hex case-insensitive &#x4A; vs &#X4A; vs &#x4a;.
